#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INFINITY = 1000000000;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    if (n > m) {
        swap(n, m);
    }

    int size = 1 << n;
    vector<vector<int>> dp(size, vector<int>(size, INFINITY));
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        dp[i][0] = 0;
    }

    for (int step = 0; step < m; step++) {
        vector<vector<int>> nextStates(size, vector<int>(size, INFINITY));
        for (int prevMask = 0; prevMask < size; prevMask++) {
            for (int currMask = 0; currMask < size; currMask++) {
                if (dp[prevMask][currMask] != INFINITY) {
                    int limit = (step == m - 1) ? 1 : size;
                    for (int nextMask = 0; nextMask < limit; nextMask++) {
                        int covered = 0;
                        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                            if (((1 << i) & currMask) == 0) {
                                int up = i - 1;
                                int down = i + 1;
                                if (up >= 0 && ((1 << up) & currMask) != 0)
                                    covered |= 1 << i;
                                if (down < n && ((1 << down) & currMask) != 0)
                                    covered |= 1 << i;
                                if (((1 << i) & prevMask) != 0)
                                    covered |= 1 << i;
                                if (((1 << i) & nextMask) != 0)
                                    covered |= 1 << i;
                            }
                        }
                        int cost = dp[prevMask][currMask] + n - __builtin_popcount(covered);
                        if (cost < nextStates[prevMask][nextMask]) {
                            nextStates[prevMask][nextMask] = cost;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        dp = nextStates;
    }

    int minCost = INFINITY;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
            if (dp[i][j] < minCost) {
                minCost = dp[i][j];
            }
        }
    }
    cout << n * m - minCost << "\n";

    return 0;
}
